scope-1985: Nucleus: an external switch is an implementor-defined and implementor-named device (named through an implementor-name in SPECIAL-NAMES, see VI-13)

citations.quote: defined and named by the implementor
citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.5 p1  (4.5 EXTERNAL SWITCH)  the text is in p1

citations.quote: Switch-name-1 identifies an implementor-defined external switch
citations.check: OK  §2023:12.3.7.4 GR2  (General rules)  the text is in GR2

cases.reason: 1985: "An external switch is a hardware or software device, defined and named by the implementor, which is used to indicate that one of two alternate states exists. These alternate states are referred to as the on status and the off status". 2023 GR-12.3.7.4-2 states the same: an implementor-defined external switch with an on status and an off status. Flagged definitional but observable: pb862_implementor_names runs at 85, names SWITCH-3 from the implementor's table and shows both statuses (SW3=OFF, then SW3=ON).
